text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting the internal release note for v2.3.1. Change window: Fri Mar 27 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need: short ops blurb, rollback plan, version pin guidance, and a 1-line customer-facing note for PMs. @ajay can you confirm rollback thresholds? @sophia will draft the customer line.

ajay: Yup. Rollback proposal: canary at 10% for 30m, then 50% for 15m. Auto rollback if error rate > 3% or p95 latency regresses by >30% over baseline for 5m. Fallback target: pin traffic to `v2.2.9` and disable new KV-cache flag.

ajay: Playbook snippet:
```
# promote canary
kubectl apply -f k8s/canary-v2.3.1.yaml
# manual rollback
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:v2.2.9 --namespace=prod
# metric check (prometheus)
ALERT if increase(rate(http_errors[5m])) > 0.03
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for service=redwood-api version=v2.3.1 percent=10

sophia: Draft for internal note (short):
- Release v2.3.1: performance improvements to KV cache and kernel selection; ~8-12% median token latency improvement.
- Risk/rollback: will pin to v2.2.9 if errors/latency thresholds hit.
- Ops actions: canary -> monitor -> ramp -> full. See playbook link: <https://internal.redwood/release/playbook/2.3.1> :thumbsup:

danielle: Add migration bullet: hosted customers with custom KV config will need to opt-in if they relied on legacy sharding. Also call out Dedicated customers: ops will coordinate manual pin for any Dedicated pools during the window.

kevin: For the announcement, can we include a 1-liner for Sales/CS: "Improved inference latency and lower per-token cost for common seq lengths; no action required."

maria: Good. I'll fold Sophia + Kevin wording, include Danielle's migration note, and paste Ajay's playbook link. Plan: send draft to #announcements tomorrow 09:00 PT for review, then schedule the deploy per the window.

deploy-bot: Canary health: OK (errors 0.2%, p95 latency delta +5%). Monitoring for 30m.

ajay: If health stays OK I'll promote to 50% at +30m. If anything spikes I'll cut to 0 and pin to v2.2.9.

maria: Perfect — I'll post the internal note in this thread in ~30m for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
